name: Hack Squat Calf Raise
summary: A machine-based lower leg isolation exercise performed on an inclined hack squat sled to target the calf musculature through deep ankle plantarflexion.

aliases.text: Calf Raise using Hack Squat Machine

setup: Position your back and shoulders firmly against the hack squat backrest and shoulder pads.
Place the balls of your feet on the bottom edge of the footplate, allowing your heels to hang freely off the edge.
Disengage the machine safeties and extend your legs, keeping a slight, soft micro-bend in the knees to avoid hyperextension.
steps: Lower your heels in a slow, controlled motion past the level of the platform until you feel a deep stretch throughout your calves.
Pause briefly at the bottom to eliminate elastic bounce.
Press firmly through the balls of your feet and big toes to raise your heels as high as possible into full plantarflexion.
Squeeze your calves forcefully at the peak contraction before lowering into the next repetition.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you push onto your toes; inhale as you slowly lower your heels into the stretch.
cues: Keep the knees fixed, not bouncing.

common_faults.fault: Bending and straightening the knees to assist the lift.
common_faults.correction: Keep the knees locked in a fixed, micro-bent position throughout the entire set so the calves do all the work.

common_faults.fault: Bouncing out of the bottom position.
common_faults.correction: Hold a distinct pause at the bottom stretch to eliminate the stretch reflex and maximize muscle tension.

common_faults.fault: Placing too little of the foot on the platform, risking slippage.
common_faults.correction: Ensure the entire balls of your feet and toes are secure on the edge of the footplate before loading weight.

precautions: Ensure your footwear has reliable tread to prevent slipping off the edge of the footplate.
Always re-engage the machine safeties before stepping off the platform.
